_about: Readings for signs Kiraly & Tokai leave undefined, made their way: guessed from one passage, then checked at every occurrence in the book. Tier A fits every occurrence checked or is proved by an identical formula or a numeral; B fits most; C is a guess. Keys are glyph codes minus E000, three hex digits per glyph.
